Illustrative District Facility Delivery Report


Reporting years: 2021 to 2023

This short digital PDF is a synthetic benchmark fixture. It contains no personal records and must not be
described as official statistics.



Indicator definition
Facility delivery coverage is the percentage of recorded deliveries that occurred in a health facility. The
report supplies percentages only; it does not supply counts or causal explanations.


Source label: synthetic facility-delivery PDF fixture. The data table is Table 1 on page 2.
